name: airoom
description: airoom — a spatial control room for your Claude agents. airoom.dev

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.app: npm run build --prefix web && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server && npm run dist:unsigned --prefix desktop
